summary: Local CP-004 implementation verification: 69 automated checks passed, TypeScript and targeted ESLint checks passed, production build passed, and browser flows verified at desktop and 390px compact width.

checks.title: Read exact frozen context and separate current associations
checks.detail: API/MCP agreement verified for snapshot identity, exact unchanged frozen payload, explicit null metadata, first-included proposals, derived proposal commits, history and list schemas. Reads do not write; all 18 tools are discoverable. Existing MCP authentication rejection regression checks pass.

checks.title: Stable proposal inclusion and reciprocal navigation
checks.detail: Tests cover additions/edits/deletions applied atomically to one snapshot, pending/rejected states, request-changes/rebase, valid legacy references, unknown and unavailable provenance, same-project resolution, and original-link stability after later snapshots and edits. Real D1 failure rolls back application and association. Browser verified keyboard proposal-to-snapshot and snapshot-to-proposal navigation and exact frozen requirements.

checks.title: Editable snapshot commits with immutable content and durable corrections
checks.detail: Tests verify 40/64-character normalization, invalid/empty/abbreviated IDs, malformed/relative/non-HTTPS/credentialed/oversize URLs, optional-field whole replacement, explicit clear, no-ops, repository rename/removal, shared commit across snapshots, and preserved snapshots, nonempty evidence, requirement revisions and lifecycle events. 508 corrections survived the 500-entry Activity cap. Imports omit or forge metadata without replacing local records. Browser verified add, replace, copy, cancel, validation input retention, clear, removed-repository preservation, saved history, reload, and 390px layout.

checks.title: Shared API/MCP persistence, retries, isolation and executed outcomes
checks.detail: Dedicated application endpoint and set_snapshot_implementation tool share validation and durable idempotency. Tests cover stale saves, cross-project isolation with overlapping IDs, missing targets, query-bound bounded history and invalidated cursors, origin rejection, receipt rollback, competing writes, duplicate durable retries, normalized no-op receipts and worker replacement with real D1. Browser verified stale-save rejection, retained input, reload-and-retry recovery, and derived proposal display. This report is tied to BL-005 and the exact listed revisions.

verification_scope: Local implementation and loopback preview verification only. Hosted CP-004 deployment and hosted OAuth/revocation have not been performed or re-tested. No requirement lifecycle status is changed. Commit references are user-supplied metadata; tests do not clone repositories or validate remote commit existence.
